Your assistant, built for your field.

Consulting that builds your own AI assistant on our platform, bespoke to your field: what companies like yours already hand to AI, wired to your own systems, run in a room where your people decide and every step leaves a receipt.

Start an engagement See what your field hands to AI

How an engagement runs

  1. Ask

    You name the work you want off your desk, in your own words.

  2. Match

    We find the adoptions closest to yours among the 320 in the ledger, with their sources and what they cost in effort.

  3. Build your assistant

    We set up your assistant on the harness for your field: its skills, its vocabulary, the records it keeps, the tools it may touch.

  4. Open the room

    Your people, your assistant and our specialist join one room. Your tools connect only where you allow it.

  5. Plan

    The agent drafts the plan as steps, each with an owner and a date.

  6. Decide

    Every decision lands in the inbox of the person who owns it, as a proposal with a deadline. Nothing moves without a yes.

  7. Receipt

    Each finished step leaves a receipt: what was asked, who did it, what it cost.

  8. Keep

    The assistant stays yours, as a pack: the room, the plan, the connections and the record.

An example engagement; the names and numbers are illustrative.

What you keep

Your assistant
Built for your field on the harness, with its skills, its records and its permissions, in a room with your people and the record of every task and decision, after we leave.
The pack
The plan, the connections and the rules, packaged so the next team can start from it.
The receipts
What was asked, who did it and what it cost, step by step. You choose what of it is shown publicly.

Questions

Do we have to use massrelay?

Your assistant is built on the massrelay harness and lives in a room there, because that is where its permissions, the plan, the decisions and the receipts live. The guide and its sources are open to anyone.

Is it a product or a service?

Both, in that order of who does the work: we do the consulting, your assistant does the work after. The harness is the product; the engagement makes it yours.

Which countries do you work in?

Any. What changes by country is the law and the channels people use. The adoptions come from 40 countries, and the law page compares the rules country by country.

How much does it cost?

Each engagement is priced before it starts, by its size. You see the price and say yes before anyone is paid.

Is the guide neutral?

Every adoption links the page we read. Where the only source is the vendor's own, the line says so.
